description: This file defines classes and functions related to PyTorch's autograd system, including custom autograd.Function subclasses, context management, and support for forward and backward differentiation modes.

classes.name: FunctionCtx
classes.description: Context class providing methods for saving tensors, marking tensors as dirty or non-differentiable, and other autograd-related utilities.

classes.name: BackwardCFunction
classes.description: Internal class used for autograd backward node representation, not for public use.

classes.name: FunctionMeta
classes.description: Metaclass for autograd Function classes, responsible for setting up backward class.

classes.name: _SingleLevelFunction
classes.description: Base class for user-defined autograd functions, providing static methods for forward, backward, setup_context, and vmap support.

classes.name: Function
classes.description: Base class for creating custom autograd functions, with static methods to define forward, backward, and other differentiation behaviors.

classes.name: InplaceFunction
classes.description: Legacy class for autograd functions that modify tensors in-place; use Function instead.

classes.name: NestedIOFunction
classes.description: Legacy class supporting nested input/output structures for autograd functions; use Function instead.

methods.name: save_for_backward
methods.description: Stores tensors for use in the backward pass.

methods.name: save_for_forward
methods.description: Stores tensors for use in the JVP (forward mode differentiation).

methods.name: mark_non_differentiable
methods.description: Marks outputs as non-differentiable to optimize backward computation.

methods.name: set_materialize_grads
methods.description: Configures whether to materialize gradient tensors.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the autograd function, handling context setup and differentiation modes.

methods.name: forward_extended
methods.description: User-defined method for forward pass in nested structures.

methods.name: backward_extended
methods.description: User-defined method for backward pass in nested structures.
